qa_audit.ip_note: "RoadWise" is descriptive/generic (used by various unrelated road-safety/driver programs), presented in-fiction with a ™; not a distinctive real trademark, treat as fictional. Only real name used as a channel is none; Adobe/Stock/Firefly are platform. Minor: brand naming is inconsistent — client is "RoadWise" but several filenames/outputs are "driving_sense"/"drivingsense" (wordmark, icons.svg, kit_board), a leftover from an earlier "DrivingSense" name.
qa_audit.doable_note: Step 8 (image_fill_area) cannot do what it claims: it fills a masked region of an EXISTING image with solid color within the current canvas — it cannot enlarge/extend a 1024x1024 frame onto a new 1080x1920 canvas or composite the frame onto a larger solid ground. Going square→vertical canvas is a canvas-extension op the connector only offers via image_generative_expand (BANNED). No non-generative solid-fill path achieves this. Worse, the spec still carries live references to the banned capability the reverify claims was removed: output spec line 72 says the cover is "outpainted top+bottom to 9:16"; chaining_note (line 270) says "→ generative_expand to 9:16 (8)"; difficulty_rationale (line 271) says "The one generative step is image_generative_expand (outpaint) only". These contradict the patched workflow and reference a banned tool. All other steps (remove_bg, vectorize, preset/temp/single-color-sat grade, stock license+add_grain, media_enhance_speech [A], video_resize same-length [A], font_recommend, firefly board) are real, doable connector actions.
qa_audit.presentation_note: Well-structured overall: one deliverable kit, full_brief, inputs with realism_notes, outputs with specs, mostly coherent chain, reverify present. But: (1) output spec, chaining_note, and difficulty_rationale still describe outpaint / image_generative_expand at step 8, contradicting the image_fill_area used in connector_workflow — stale, uncleaned text referencing a banned capability; (2) step 8's image_fill_area note describes a canvas-extension/placement it cannot perform; (3) brand naming drift ("RoadWise" vs "driving_sense"/"drivingsense" filenames).
qa_audit.top_issue: Cover/end-card step 8 is not connector-doable — image_fill_area cannot extend a 1024x1024 frame onto a 1080x1920 canvas (that needs the banned image_generative_expand), and the output spec/chaining_note/difficulty_rationale still reference outpaint/generative_expand, a banned capability.
